TC-LOGIN-001.description:
The login page shows everything a user needs to log in
Why: if any control is missing or disabled, nobody can log in to the admin portal.
TC-LOGIN-001.preconditions:
- The BigWin admin portal (dev) is reachable: https://e763fesnjnk.dev.accelr.net
- You are NOT logged in (use a private / incognito browser window)
steps: Open the login page in the browser
Look at the browser tab title
Check the "Email address" box, the "Password" box and the "Login" button
Check the "Forgot password" link and the information message under the form
TC-LOGIN-001.expectedResult:
- The browser tab title is "Login | BigWin"
- "Email address", "Password" and "Login" are shown and can be used (not greyed out)
- The "Forgot password" link is shown
- An information message starting with "You can use ..." is shown
TC-LOGIN-001.postconditions: Nothing is changed in the system (no data is created)

TC-LOGIN-002.description:
An admin with the correct email, password and one-time code (OTP) is logged in
Why: this is the only way into the admin portal - every other workflow starts here.
TC-LOGIN-002.preconditions:
- The BigWin admin portal (dev) is reachable: https://e763fesnjnk.dev.accelr.net
- You are NOT logged in (use a private / incognito browser window)
- An active admin account (email + password) - the test account in config/env/dev.json
TC-LOGIN-002.testData:
- Email and password of the admin account
- OTP: the 6-digit code sent to the admin (on dev the test code from config/env/dev.json)
steps: Open the login page
Type the admin email in "Email address" and the password in "Password"
Click "Login"
In the "Verify OTP" window, type the 6-digit OTP
Click the submit button of the "Verify OTP" window
Accept the message the browser shows
TC-LOGIN-002.expectedResult:
- After "Login" the "Verify OTP" window opens
- After the OTP the browser shows the message "Successfully validated OTP"
- The dashboard (Home) opens with the menu on the left - the admin is logged in
TC-LOGIN-002.postconditions: The admin is logged in (the session is saved in the browser)

TC-LT-APR-001.description:
A new lottery type waits for review and cannot be approved straight away
Why: a second person must check every new type (review first, then approve).
TC-LT-APR-001.preconditions:
- Logged in to the BigWin admin portal (dev) as admin
- The Lottery Type page is open (left menu "Lottery" > "Lottery Type")
TC-LT-APR-001.testData:
- New lottery type: Code "AT<unique number>", Type "Auto Type <unique number>", Status ACTIVE
- Stages: "Under Review" (new / edited) -> Review -> "Pending Approval" -> Approve -> "Approved"
steps: Click "Add New Type", enter the Code and Type, choose the Status, click "Create" (the page reloads and the new row is listed)
Find the row by its Code, click the "..." actions button at the end of the row and choose "Edit" - the "Update Lottery Type" window opens
Look at the Stage and the buttons offered
Clean up: delete the lottery types created by this test (row "..." menu > "Delete")
TC-LT-APR-001.expectedResult:
- Stage is "Under Review"
- The button "Review" is offered
- The button "Approve" is NOT offered
TC-LT-APR-001.postconditions: The lottery types created by the test are deleted (only codes starting with "AT" are ever deleted)

TC-LT-APR-002.description:
"Review" moves a new lottery type on to "Pending Approval"

TC-LT-APR-002.preconditions:
- Logged in to the BigWin admin portal (dev) as admin
- The Lottery Type page is open (left menu "Lottery" > "Lottery Type")
- The test has created its own lottery type (Code "AT<number>", Type "Auto Type <number>", Status Active)
- Its Stage is "Under Review"
TC-LT-APR-002.testData: - Stages: "Under Review" (new / edited) -> Review -> "Pending Approval" -> Approve -> "Approved"
steps: Find the row by its Code, click the "..." actions button at the end of the row and choose "Edit" - the "Update Lottery Type" window opens
Click "Review"
Open "Edit" on the row again and look at the Stage and the buttons
Clean up: delete the lottery types created by this test (row "..." menu > "Delete")
TC-LT-APR-002.expectedResult:
- Stage is "Pending Approval"
- The button "Approve" is now offered
- "Review" is no longer offered
TC-LT-APR-002.postconditions: The lottery types created by the test are deleted (only codes starting with "AT" are ever deleted)
